tests.name: Contract, Host Remote Event, and TLS carrier suites

implemented: Fresh pairing transfers endpoint, pin, credential, clientId, and transport ownership to the replacement Link client before the UI uses it.
The client consumes the generated unary, stream, ready, request, outcome, cancel, result, and structured error models; void RPC success does not require a value field.
Reconnect clears stale generation identity and accepts only the next authoritative ready and snapshot state.
The Swift native driver consumes the same 13-step pair-through-revoke corpus as the TypeScript and Kotlin drivers.
The Apple workflow boots the shipped base plus desktop Host composition and publishes native evidence on a Swift-capable runner.
acceptance: Generated Swift models, the shared corpus, the real Host harness, and the Swift driver are present.
Source and workflow inspection cannot substitute for a real SwiftPM or Host-to-Swift run.
